display.purpose: Screen titles, one per screen. SF Pro Display 700.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked instrument labels for status/section meaning.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: Compose bar glass and slash-command popover. State-driven, not ambient.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Create-issue primary-action circle. Affordance, not resting decoration.

motion.name: pressed-opacity
motion.purpose: Button pressed state. No scale or shadow animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled system-accent button. The only filled button on a screen; reserved for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0A84FF; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,132,255,0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered button. The default button; clear fill over hover tint with a 0.5px border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #000000; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0.5px solid rgba(60,60,67,0.3); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,132,255,0.35); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Capsule encoding one status. Color at 12% fill, semibold caption text in the color, 6px dot or 9px SF Symbol.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #0A84FF; background: rgba(10,132,255,0.12); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0A84FF; }

components.name: Stat Pill
components.description: Instrument-reading stat: 7px filled dot with glow, rounded-bold count, caption label.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #34C759; box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(52,199,89,0.6); } .ds-stat b { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat { color: #3C3C4399; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Raised Card / Tile
components.description: Material-backed rounded rectangle with a hairline border. Flat at rest; system provides drag shadow. 22px radius for tiles, 14px for work cards.

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 18px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 0.5px solid rgba(60,60,67,0.18); border-radius: 22px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-card-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 30px; height: 30px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; color: #0A84FF; background: rgba(10,132,255,0.12); border-radius: 9px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #000000; } .ds-card-chevron { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: #3C3C434C; } .ds-card-body { color: #000000; }

components.name: Inset Well / Kanban Column
components.description: Recessed rounded rectangle for fields and kanban columns. Inset fill, 0.5–1px border, 16px radius.
components.css: .ds-inset { padding: 12px; background: #F5F5F5; border: 1px solid rgba(60,60,67,0.3); border-radius: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-inset-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(60,60,67,0.18); } .ds-inset-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0A84FF; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(10,132,255,0.6); } .ds-inset-title { font-family: ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1.2px; color: #000000; } .ds-inset-count { font-family: ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #3C3C434C; background: #E5E5EA; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Chat Bubble (Assistant)
components.description: Material-backed assistant bubble, 24px radius, accent-cyan Hermes label, tool chips above content.
components.css: .ds-bubble { padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; max-width: 65ch; } .ds-bubble-assistant { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(60,60,67,0.18); color: #000000; } .ds-bubble-sender { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #0A84FF; margin-bottom: 8px; }

components.name: Chat Bubble (User)
components.description: Solid accent-filled user bubble, no border, white text, accent-orange You label.
components.css: .ds-bubble-user { background: #0A84FF; border: none; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; max-width: 65ch; margin-left: 40px; } .ds-bubble-sender-you { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #FF9500; margin-bottom: 8px; }

narrative.overview: AgentBoard is a native console for a fleet of Hermes-driven coding agents. The aesthetic is calm at idle, clear in motion. The user is a power developer who runs multiple agent sessions, triages work, and steers agents mid-flight; the interface treats them as someone who knows what they're doing and stays out of their way. The system is native macOS/iOS first. Surfaces, materials, controls, and motion come from the platform; depth is carried by native materials and hairline borders, not bespoke shadows. Color is semantic: a small consistent vocabulary maps kanban columns, work states, session states, and chat connection to meaning. Decoration carries no weight; if a color or motion does not encode state, it does not belong.
keyCharacteristics: Native chrome over custom chrome (NavigationSplitView, .inspector, .sidebar, system materials, system accent)
Flat by default; shadows appear only on state (drag, float)
Restrained color: one accent, a small semantic status vocabulary, tinted-native neutrals
Dense information for power users, progressive disclosure at decision points
Consistent component vocabulary screen to screen; delight saved for moments, not pages

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The system accent is used on primary actions, current selection, and the ready/open status only, never as decoration. ≤10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Orange means progress or blocked; coral means error or stop; green means success; the accent means primary/open. Never repaint a status color for variety.

rules.name: The Native Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Neutrals come from the OS (windowBackgroundColor, controlBackgroundColor, underPageBackgroundColor). Never hand-roll a neutral hex; the OS owns light/dark adaptation.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: SF Pro carries headings, body, labels, and data. No display/body pairing, no editorial serif. System fonts are a feature.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked label style signals instrument label and maps to status/section meaning. If a label carries no semantic weight, set it in body weight, not eyebrow.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (drag, float, focus). Never add an ambient card shadow.

rules.name: The Material Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Raised = .regularMaterial or Control; recessed = Inset or .tertiary. Do not invent a third material layer.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders are 0.5px (soft) or 1px (standard). Anything thicker is skeuomorphic and forbidden.

dos: Do use native platform materials and colors (windowBackgroundColor, controlBackgroundColor, underPageBackgroundColor, .regularMaterial). The OS owns light/dark adaptation.
Do keep the System Accent to primary actions, current selection, and the ready/open status — ≤10% of any screen (The One Voice Rule).

Do map every status to the semantic vocabulary: orange = progress/blocked, coral = error/stop, green = success, accent = primary/open. Pair color with a dot, icon, or text label so it reads beyond hue.
Do carry depth with materials and 0.5–1px hairlines. Shadows appear only on state: drag, float, the primary action's lift (The Flat-By-Default Rule).
Do use SF Pro for everything; create hierarchy with weight and scale (≥1.25 step ratio). Reserve the uppercase tracked eyebrow for instrument labels that carry meaning.
Do put accessibility identifiers on every interactive element ({screen}_{element}_{description}) and .monospacedDigit() on all numeric stats.
Do keep component vocabulary consistent screen to screen — same button shape, same pill style, same card radius family.
donts: Don't use neumorphic double-shadows, extruded/recessed skeuomorphic surfaces, or any vestige of the retired beads prototype.

Don't paint in the AI dashboard slop lane — dark navy backgrounds, neon accent glows, gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient), hero-metric templates, or identical icon+heading+text card grids.
Don't add ambient card shadows at rest. If it is not being dragged or floating, it is flat.
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored side-stripe accent on cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't reinvent standard affordances — custom scrollbars, non-native form controls, Electron-grade chrome. The app reads as a first-class macOS/iOS citizen.
Don't repaint a status color for variety or decoration. Color means state, always.
Don't put a display font in a UI label, button, or data cell. The eyebrow style is uppercase tracked, not decorative.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Glass is reserved for floating chrome (compose bar, terminal header) where content scrolls behind it.
Don't use em dashes in copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
